portions.title: How much for each plate
portions.text: Weigh the cooked dish and see right away how many grams go on each plate — and what that is in dry weight for your calorie tracker.

oneWeight.title: Enter just one weight
oneWeight.text: The dish remembers the dry weight, the container, the party and the shares. At the stove you only enter the cooked weight.

shares.title: Equal or by shares
shares.text: Save some for tomorrow, or split a week's batch into portions without names. Swipe a portion to copy it for your tracker.

withAccount1: Dishes on all your devices, even after you change phones
withAccount2: Shared with family: a cooked weight one person enters shows up for everyone
withoutAccountText: Data is kept only in this browser. You can sign in later in Settings — the data will move to your account.
